name: Harvy — crt.sh Certificate Transparency Ingestion
description: crtsh: Ingests Certificate Transparency logs from crt.sh (source_id=src_crtsh) into R2 (harvy-artifacts/crtsh/) and Basin evidence with event_id dedupe. OpenObserve: service="n8n".

nodeGroups.name: Fetch and Deduplicate
nodeGroups.description: Fetch certificate transparency logs from crt.sh and filter out existing records

nodeGroups.name: Persist and Stream
nodeGroups.description: Upload raw certificate JSON to R2, stream evidence to Cloudflare Basin, and record ingested event

nodeGroups.name: Error Logging
nodeGroups.description: Record workflow execution errors into crtsh_errors data table
